name: game-kit
description: The first-person player for Volt 3D games: mouse look, walking, running, crouching, jumping, gravity, head bob, and solid boxes that stop you or that you can climb onto. Written for `import "game.volt"` - World Studio adds that line for you, and every setting (speed, jump height, how tall the player is) is a plain variable you change with one line. Paste the snippet in instead if you want a .volt file that works outside Volt Studio.

snippets.label: Game kit (player, gravity, collision)
snippets.description: Normally used as `import "game.volt"`. Paste it in only when the file has to stand on its own - the settings at the top are the same either way.
